verses.text: I will bless Jehovah at all times: His praise shall continually be in my mouth.

segments.text: I will bless Jehovah at all times:
His praise shall continually be in my mouth.

verses.text: My soul shall make her boast in Jehovah: The meek shall hear thereof, and be glad.

segments.text: My soul shall make her boast in Jehovah:
The meek shall hear thereof, and be glad.

verses.text: Oh magnify Jehovah with me, And let us exalt his name together.

segments.text: Oh magnify Jehovah with me,
And let us exalt his name together.

verses.text: I sought Jehovah, and he answered me, And delivered me from all my fears.

segments.text: I sought Jehovah, and he answered me,
And delivered me from all my fears.

verses.text: They looked unto him, and were radiant; And their faces shall never be confounded.

segments.text: They looked unto him, and were radiant;
And their faces shall never be confounded.

verses.text: This poor man cried, and Jehovah heard him, And saved him out of all his troubles.

segments.text: This poor man cried, and Jehovah heard him,
And saved him out of all his troubles.

verses.text: The angel of Jehovah encampeth round about them that fear him, And delivereth them.

segments.text: The angel of Jehovah encampeth round about them that fear him,
And delivereth them.

verses.text: Oh taste and see that Jehovah is good: Blessed is the man that taketh refuge in him.

segments.text: Oh taste and see that Jehovah is good:
Blessed is the man that taketh refuge in him.

verses.text: Oh fear Jehovah, ye his saints; For there is no want to them that fear him.

segments.text: Oh fear Jehovah, ye his saints;
For there is no want to them that fear him.

verses.text: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger; But they that seek Jehovah shall not want any good thing.

segments.text: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger;
But they that seek Jehovah shall not want any good thing.

verses.text: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of Jehovah.

segments.text: Come, ye children, hearken unto me:
I will teach you the fear of Jehovah.

verses.text: What man is he that desireth life, And loveth many days, that he may see good?

segments.text: What man is he that desireth life,
And loveth
many
days, that he may see good?

verses.text: Keep thy tongue from evil, And thy lips from speaking guile.

segments.text: Keep thy tongue from evil,
And thy lips from speaking guile.

verses.text: Depart from evil, and do good; Seek peace, and pursue it.

segments.text: Depart from evil, and do good;
Seek peace, and pursue it.

verses.text: The eyes of Jehovah are toward the righteous, And his ears are open unto their cry.

segments.text: The eyes of Jehovah are toward the righteous,
And his ears are
open
unto their cry.

verses.text: The face of Jehovah is against them that do evil, To cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.

segments.text: The face of Jehovah is against them that do evil,
To cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.

verses.text: The righteous cried, and Jehovah heard, And delivered them out of all their troubles.

segments.text: The righteous
cried, and Jehovah heard,
And delivered them out of all their troubles.

verses.text: Jehovah is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart, And saveth such as are of a contrite spirit.

segments.text: Jehovah is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart,
And saveth such as are of a contrite spirit.

verses.text: Many are the afflictions of the righteous; But Jehovah delivereth him out of them all.

segments.text: Many are the afflictions of the righteous;
But Jehovah delivereth him out of them all.

verses.text: He keepeth all his bones: Not one of them is broken.

segments.text: He keepeth all his bones:
Not one of them is broken.

verses.text: Evil shall slay the wicked; And they that hate the righteous shall be condemned.

segments.text: Evil shall slay the wicked;
And they that hate the righteous shall be condemned.

verses.text: Jehovah redeemeth the soul of his servants; And none of them that take refuge in him shall be condemned.

segments.text: Jehovah redeemeth the soul of his servants;
And none of them that take refuge in him shall be condemned.

headings.text: A Psalm of David; when he changed his behavior before Abimelech, who drove him away, and he departed.
